title: I Will Sing of the Steadfast Love of the Lord

questions.question: I will sing of the steadfast love of the Lord, how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:1 (ESV): "I will sing of the steadfast love of the Lord, forever;"

questions.question: With my mouth I will make known your faithfulness to all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:1 (ESV): "...I will make known your faithfulness to all generations."

questions.question: For I said, "Steadfast love will be built up forever; in the heavens you will establish your what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:2 (ESV): "...in the heavens you will establish your faithfulness."

questions.question: I have made a covenant with my chosen one; I have sworn to David my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:3 (ESV): "I have made a covenant with my chosen one; I have sworn to David my servant:"

questions.question: I will establish your offspring forever and build your throne for all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:4 (ESV): "I will establish your offspring forever and build your throne for all generations."

questions.question: Let the heavens praise your wonders, O Lord, your faithfulness in the assembly of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:5 (ESV): "...your faithfulness in the assembly of the holy ones."

questions.question: For who in the skies can be compared to the Lord? Who among the heavenly beings is like the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:6 (ESV): "Who among the heavenly beings is like the Lord,"

questions.question: God is greatly to be feared in the council of the holy ones, and awesome above all who are around whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:7 (ESV): "...and awesome above all who are around him?"

questions.question: You rule the raging of the sea; when its waves rise, you do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:9 (ESV): "...when its waves rise, you still them."

questions.question: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; you scattered your enemies with your mighty what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:10 (ESV): "You crushed Rahab like a carcass; you scattered your enemies with your mighty arm."

questions.question: The heavens are yours; the earth also is yours; the world and all that is in it, you have what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:11 (ESV): "...the world and all that is in it, you have founded them."

questions.question: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne; steadfast love and faithfulness go before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:14 (ESV): "...steadfast love and faithfulness go before you."

questions.question: I have found David, my servant; with my holy oil I have what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:20 (ESV): "with my holy oil I have anointed him,"

questions.question: He shall cry to me, "You are my Father, my God, and the Rock of my what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:26 (ESV): "...and the Rock of my salvation."

questions.question: Blessed be the Lord forever! Amen and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 89:52 (ESV): "Blessed be the Lord forever! Amen and Amen."

key_verse_text: I will sing of the steadfast love of the Lord, forever; with my mouth I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
